{{#invoke:infobox|infobox
| defaultimagesize = 150px 
| invimage = none
| imagecaption = {{#if: {{{image2|}}} | Icon }}
| image2caption = {{#if: {{{image2|}}} | Sprite }}
| rows =
{{infobox row|Type|{{#if: {{{type|}}} |
{{#switch: {{lc:{{{type}}}}}
  |melee weapon = [[File:Filter melee default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]
  |ranged weapon = [[File:Filter ranged default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]
  |armor = [[File:Filter armour default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]
  |artifact = [[File:Filter consume default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]
  |cosmetic = [[File:Filter cosmetic default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]
  |[[File:Filter item default.png|16px|link=|alt=]]}} [[MCD:{{{type}}}|{{{type}}}]] | ? }} }}
{{#if: {{{rarity|}}}
| {{Infobox row|[[MCD:Rarity|Rarity]]|{{DungeonsRarity|{{{rarity}}}}}}}
}}
{{#if: {{{stat|}}} | {{
  #switch: {{lc:{{{stat|}}}}}
  |melee = 
  {{#if: {{{stat1|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Power|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat1|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat1|}}} }} }}
  {{#if: {{{stat2|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Speed|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat2|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat2|}}} }} }}
  {{#if: {{{stat3|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Area|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat3|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat3|}}} }} }}
  |ranged = 
  {{#if: {{{stat1|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Power|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat1|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat1|}}} }} }}
  {{#if: {{{stat2|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Speed|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat2|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat2|}}} }} }}
  {{#if: {{{stat3|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|class=nowrap|Ammo|{{DungeonsStat|{{#expr:{{formatnum:{{{stat3|}}}|R}}/14*100}} }} {{{stat3|}}} }} }}
  {{#if: {{{stat4|}}} 
    | {{infobox row|Charge|{{
      #switch: {{{stat4|}}}
      |fast = Fast
      |slow = Slow
    }} }} }}
  }}
}}
{{#if: {{{property|}}} 
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Properties|field={{{property|}}} }}
}}
{{#if: {{{enchantment|}}} 
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Enchantment|field=
{{DuEnchantmentLink|{{{enchantment|}}} }}
{{#if: {{{enchantment2|}}}
| <br/>{{DuEnchantmentLink|{{{enchantment2|}}} }}
}} }}
}}
{{#if: {{{damagetype|}}} 
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Damage type|field={{{damagetype|}}}}}
}}
{{#if: {{{combo|}}}
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Combo|field={{{combo|}}} }}
}}
{{#if: {{{soulenchantments|}}}
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Souls|field={{{soulenchantments|?}}} }}
}}
{{#if: {{{runes|}}}
        | {{infobox row
		| class = list-style-none
		| label = [[MCD:Ancient Offering|Runes]]
		| field = {{{runes|}}}
	}}
}}
{{#if: {{{variant|}}} 
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=Variants|field=
* {{DuItemLink|{{{variant|}}}}}
{{#if: {{{variant2|}}} | 
* {{DuItemLink|{{{variant2|}}}}}
}}
{{#if: {{{variant3|}}} | 
* {{DuItemLink|{{{variant3|}}}}}
}}
{{#if: {{{variant4|}}} | 
* {{DuItemLink|{{{variant4|}}}}}
}} }}
}}
{{#if: {{{missions|}}} 
| {{infobox row|class=list-style-none|label=[[MCD:Mission|Missions]] found in|field={{{missions|}}}}}
}}
{{#if: {{{flavor|}}} | 
{{infobox row
  | class = list-style-none
  | field = <div style="text-align:center;">{{#if: {{{flavorlabel|}}} | '''{{{flavorlabel}}}''' | '''In-game flavor text'''}}<br>{{{flavor}}}</div>
}} }}
{{#if: {{{codename|}}} |{{Infobox row|Codename|{{{codename|}}}}}}}
| footer =
{{#if: {{{description|}}} | {{#if: {{{desclabel|}}} | '''{{{desclabel}}}''' | '''In-game description'''}}<br>{{{description}}} }}
}}<noinclude>
{{Documentation}}
[[Category:Templates with inline CSS colors]]
<!-- Please put the category/language link on the documentation page -->
</noinclude>
